title: Data Architecture & Schema Design Document
summary: project-management/design/02-data-architecture.md — full ER diagram across all 7 tables sourced from the 6 real migration files, column dictionary, indexing strategy, migration history, and a lifecycle state diagram distinguishing tombstone/purge/supersede/erase.
description:
Write project-management/design/02-data-architecture.md. Read all six migration files directly (db/migrations/0001..0006) rather than reconstructing schema from memory.

Required: (1) Mermaid erDiagram covering schema_migrations, working_memory, episodic_memory, semantic_facts, entity_profiles, procedural_memory, memory_chunks with every column/type/nullability; (2) per-table column dictionary; (3) indexing strategy (every CREATE VECTOR INDEX + supporting scope indexes, distance metric per table and why); (4) migration history table (all six, in order); (5) Mermaid stateDiagram-v2 for the data lifecycle — active -> tombstoned -> purged; active -> superseded (facts only); active -> erased as a DIRECT edge (erase_all bypasses tombstone entirely, must not be flattened into the tombstone path).

Fully independent of every other SDD story — new file only.
